text: This staff report is also about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. A mixed-use building consisting of four residential buildings is currently being constructed, by Bathurst and Front Development Ltd. at the lands municipally known as 578 Front Street West. The site is bounded by Niagara Street to the north, existing residential uses, 560 Front Street West to the east, Front Street West to the south and Bathurst Street to the west. Temporary 30 day permits were provided by to the site during the election break of 2018. Construction staging areas for the development have been setup within the north sidewalk and a portion of the westbound curb lane on Front Street West and the south sidewalk and a portion of the eastbound lane on Niagara Street abutting the site.…
